title: Disability Compensation Resumption Release: Monthly Entitlement and Months Released
content:
**Computation of the resumption release (Disability Compensation).** The resumption release is the monthly entitlement the award now carries multiplied by the months it covers, rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

- **Months covered:** the whole months elapsed from the issue date of the most recent monthly payment to today.
- **Monthly entitlement:** the veteran-alone rate of the award's combined rating plus one SMC (k) addition for each SMC (k) award on the award, up to the SMC (k) maximum — the veteran-alone rate as the Disability Compensation rate table gives it for the tier, and the SMC (k) addition of 139.87, at most 3 of them.

**Worked example (hypothetical award at Disability Compensation (40% Combined Rating) with 1 SMC (k) award).**

| Step | Figure |
|---|---|
| Most recent monthly payment issued | 1 May 2026 |
| Today | 15 September 2026 |
| Whole months elapsed | 4 |
| Monthly entitlement | 795.84 plus 139.87, that is 935.71 |
| Resumption release | 935.71 multiplied by 4, that is 3742.84 |

**SMC (k) cap illustration (hypothetical).** An award showing 4 SMC (k) awards counts 3 of them: 139.87 multiplied by 3, that is 419.61 added to the veteran-alone rate each month.
